meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码变更自动转为解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要向团队解释代码变更内容
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into explainer videos automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to your team

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能将 GitHub 拉取请求（PR）自动转化为代码变更解说视频，包含变更日志、功能展示、修复或重构讲解，基于 diff、提交记录和文件生成。
howto.when: 当你提供 PR 的完整 URL、owner/repo#N 格式引用，或在已检出仓库中提到“this PR”时触发。

say.text: 为 owner/repo#123 生成变更日志视频。
把当前仓库的 this PR 做成重构讲解视频。
say.note: Claude 会识别当前分支的 PR 并生成视频。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can turn a GitHub pull request (PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a PR URL, an owner/repo#N reference, or mention 'this PR' in a checked-out repository.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: https://github.com/user/repo/pull/42
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the PR and start building the video.

say_en.text: Make a changelog video for owner/repo#123.
say_en.note: Claude will use the PR's diff and commits to create the video.

say_en.text: Turn this PR in the current repo into a refactor walkthrough video.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the current branch's PR and generate the video.
